title: Admin Surface Design Guideline
summary: Binding admin-surface standard: flat full-bleed composition, compact disclosure-first headers, one grid for stream entries, non-redundant sober copy, project identity, operator-grade density, bounded prose width, theme tokens, and locally hosted fonts. Includes a fully specified Activity reference, a screenshot-backed violation audit, an incremental adoption contract, an explicit prohibition on nested outcome-summary boxes, the details-panel addendum, the append-only Navigation citizenship chapter with three light/dark Tree variants, a neutral waiting-decision counter recommendation, state rules, a follow-up slice boundary, visual Dos and Don'ts pairs, and an append-only Applied surfaces register.
statusReason: Normalized non-schema status/phase values ("living-standard"/"accepted") to the valid WorkbenchCatalogueService enum ("decided"/"informational"); semantics unchanged (Accepted/In-progress bucket). This is a binding, perpetually-adopted standard with an append-only Applied surfaces register, not a one-shot decided-to-documented pipeline, so it has no terminal state and stays decided indefinitely. Source AGT-2583 archived; relatedTaskKeys are surfaces that have adopted or are adopting the standard, not blocking deliverables - AGT-2579 (chronological Activity + global status) is open in 5-human-review and will update the Applied surfaces register on delivery, the rest are archived.
